items.downgrade_reason: The skip_specs exception (a marker in .openspec.yaml) cannot be expressed as an applies_when predicate, so the check is unconditional and may misfire on skip_specs changes.

sources.quote: There must be at least one spec file unless the change's `.openspec.yaml` sets `skip_specs: true` ... If the proposal lists no capabilities and `skip_specs` is not set, revisit the proposal first.
Delta operations (use ## headers): - **ADDED Requirements**: New capabilities - **MODIFIED Requirements**: Changed behavior ... - **REMOVED Requirements**: ... - **RENAMED Requirements**
Each requirement: `### Requirement: <name>` followed by description

items.downgrade_reason: Only a document-level proxy (at least one SHALL/MUST); per-requirement use cannot be checked.

sources.quote: Use SHALL/MUST for normative requirements (avoid should/may)
Each scenario: `#### Scenario: <name>` with WHEN/THEN format
Each scenario: `#### Scenario: <name>` with WHEN/THEN format
Each scenario: `#### Scenario: <name>` with WHEN/THEN format
**CRITICAL**: Scenarios MUST use exactly 4 hashtags (`####`). Using 3 hashtags or bullets will fail silently.

items.note: Needs comparing each MODIFIED block with the full main-spec requirement; no available kind does that.

sources.quote: **MODIFIED Requirements**: Changed behavior - MUST include full updated content

items.note: Per-block check that REMOVED requirements carry Reason and Migration; no applies_when predicate can tell when a REMOVED section is present.

sources.quote: **REMOVED Requirements**: Deprecated features - MUST include **Reason** and **Migration**

items.note: FROM:/TO: format only applies inside a RENAMED section, and that condition cannot be expressed.

sources.quote: **RENAMED Requirements**: Name changes only - use FROM:/TO: format

items.note: Needs a per-requirement check that a scenario exists; item_format only counts across the whole document.

sources.quote: Every requirement MUST have at least one scenario.

items.note: Needs a character-length measure per description, with existing MODIFIED blocks exempt; no available kind does this.

sources.quote: Keep each requirement's description (the text between `### Requirement:` and its first scenario) to 500 characters or fewer.

items.note: Needs comparing MODIFIED blocks with the original main-spec requirement text.

sources.quote: Under MODIFIED, keep the existing requirement block whole; never split, trim or rewrite existing text just to meet the length.

items.note: Applies per delta file, only when the capability is new (no main spec at BASE_SHA), and requires Purpose to be the first section with 50+ characters; this per-file condition and the position check cannot be expressed.

sources.quote: New capabilities only: the delta spec's first section is `## Purpose` - one or two sentences (50+ characters, or `openspec validate --strict` reports it as too brief)

items.note: Needs a per-delta-file condition (the capability's main spec exists at BASE_SHA) that cannot be expressed.

sources.quote: Do NOT add `## Purpose` to a delta for an existing capability - that spec already has one and the delta's is ignored.

unitemized.reason: Applies only when the user explicitly asks to split an existing long requirement. That condition depends on the user's intent and cannot be expressed as a predicate.

Applies only when an existing capability's Purpose is being changed. That trigger cannot be observed as a predicate, and the planningHome.root path comes from the run's response, not from a fixed pattern.
